lines.en: We live in a small apartment near the city center.
My bedroom has a big window and a comfortable bed.
Could you turn on the air conditioner, please?
The kitchen is too small, so we eat in the living room.
I have been living here for three years.
The rent is expensive, but the neighbors are friendly.
Please take off your shoes before you come in.
We need to buy a new sofa for the living room.
The washing machine is not working again.
Home is the place where I feel relaxed.
